rfq_details.title: Truck Service Bodies, Cranes & Snow Plows — Michigan County Client
rfq_details.project_name: Truck Service Bodies, Cranes & Snow Plows — Michigan County Client

introduction: Dee Davis Inc. is requesting contractor/wholesale pricing for truck service bodies, flatbed crane packages, dump bodies, and Western snow plows for a Michigan county government client. This is a 3-year contract requiring annual pricing for each year. We are the prime contractor and you would be our supplier/installer.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: Supply, install, and deliver commercial truck equipment including galvanized service bodies, Stellar cranes on flatbed platforms, Henderson stainless dump bodies, and Western snow plow systems. All items must be new with manufacturer warranty. Pricing needed for Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3.
key_requirements: New equipment only with manufacturer warranty
Warranty periods for parts and labor required
Service shop rate per hour required
Alternates accepted — list brand and model number

items.description: Service/Utility Body — 96"L x 78"W x 14.5" deep compartments, galvanized steel, SS hinges, T-handle latches, master lock, receiver hitch, 7-prong socket
items.specifications: All galvanized steel construction, body underside undercoated

items.description: Canopy Roof w/ Double Rear Doors — 45" inside height for service/utility body
Telescopic Sliding Roof/Top for Service/Utility Body
Flatbed PVM 83" w/ Steel Overlay + Stellar 4420 Crane (100' cable) + snatch block, crane cover, 2 toolboxes (18x18x36), receiver hitch, brake controller, Knap Pack KP-82E
Flatbed PVM 83" w/ Steel Overlay + Stellar 6521 Telescopic Crane (35,000 ft/lb, 6,000 lb max, 21' reach, PTO hydraulic, radio remote) + rear stabilizer, all accessories
Medium Duty Service Body + COPMA Crane model 78.2, PTO, paint match cab, 94" GG step bumper, pintle hook w/ safety chain
Henderson Mark Three Dump Body — SS sides/ends/floor, natural SS unpainted, crossmemberless unibody, 9' long, 2.5-3.7 yd, 3/16" floor, cabshield w/ punched window

Western Wide-Out Pro Plow 8-10ft w/ Ultra-Mount — cab command control, plow shoes #44277-1, wind deflector #52280, all mounting hardware, installation included
Spray-in bed liner for utility body cargo area

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Net 30 days from invoice date. Purchase orders will be issued upon award.

items.title: Delivery Requirements
items.description: FOB Destination preferred (freight included in price). Specify lead times for each item.

items.title: Contract Period
items.description: 3-Year Contract (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 pricing) with option to extend based on performance.

items.title: Product Quality
items.description: All products must be new, first-quality merchandise meeting manufacturer specifications.

items.title: Returns & Warranties
items.description: Defective items must be replaced within 5 business days at no charge.

items.title: Price Protection
items.description: Quoted prices remain firm for contract period unless mutually agreed in writing.
